text:
## Fraud Investigation  
### Investigation Process  
**Triggers:**
- Confirmed unauthorized fraud (>£1,000)
- Multiple fraud incidents (same customer/merchant)
- Fraud pattern identified (systemic issue)
- Law enforcement referral (police report filed)  
**Investigation Team:**
- Financial Crime staff (lead investigator)
- Technology team (system analysis, logs)
- Legal (if law enforcement involved)
- External forensics (if data breach suspected)  
**Investigation Elements:**
- Timeline of fraudulent transactions
- Perpetrator identification (if possible)
- Attack method analysis
- Loss quantification
- Recommendations for prevention  
**Evidence Preservation:**
- System logs retained
- Transaction records protected
- Customer communications archived
- Cooperation with law enforcement

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the investigation of confirmed fraud incidents, including triggers for investigation initiation, team composition, investigation elements, and evidence preservation requirements. Applies to unauthorized fraud exceeding £1,000, multiple incidents, systemic patterns, and law enforcement referrals.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Confirmed Unauthorized Fraud Threshold
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to initiate fraud investigation when confirmed unauthorized fraud exceeds £1,000. This threshold establishes the financial materiality level at which investigation procedures are activated.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Multiple Incidents
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to initiate fraud investigation when multiple fraud incidents are identified involving the same customer or merchant, indicating potential systemic or targeted fraud activity.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Pattern Identification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to initiate fraud investigation when a fraud pattern is identified that suggests a systemic issue affecting multiple customers or transactions.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Law Enforcement Referral
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to initiate fraud investigation when law enforcement has filed a police report or made a referral, triggering formal investigation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Team Composition
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to establish a multi-disciplinary investigation team comprising Financial Crime staff as lead investigator, Technology team for system analysis, Legal for law enforcement matters, and External forensics when data breach is suspected.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Timeline Documentation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to document a complete timeline of fraudulent transactions as part of the fraud investigation process.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Perpetrator Identification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to identify the perpetrator of fraud where possible as part of the investigation process.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Attack Method Analysis
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to analyze the attack method used in the fraud incident to understand the vulnerability exploited and inform prevention recommendations.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Loss Quantification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to quantify the financial loss resulting from the fraud incident as part of the investigation documentation.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Prevention Recommendations
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to develop and document recommendations for prevention of similar fraud incidents based on investigation findings.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Preservation - System Logs Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain system logs as evidence during fraud investigation to preserve audit trail and technical evidence.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Preservation - Transaction Records Protection
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to protect transaction records as evidence during fraud investigation to maintain integrity and chain of custody.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Preservation - Customer Communications Archival
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to archive customer communications as evidence during fraud investigation to preserve contemporaneous records and customer interactions.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Preservation - Law Enforcement Cooperation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory obligation to cooperate with law enforcement in evidence preservation and investigation procedures when law enforcement is involved in the fraud matter.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Fraud
raw_entities.description: Fraud risk involving unauthorized transactions on customer accounts, characterized by financial loss exceeding £1,000 or multiple incidents. This is a primary trigger for formal fraud investigation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Systemic Fraud Pattern
raw_entities.description: Fraud risk characterized by identification of patterns indicating systemic issues affecting multiple customers or transactions, requiring investigation to prevent recurrence.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: Data security risk involving potential unauthorized access to customer or system data, which may trigger involvement of external forensics in fraud investigation.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Staff
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for leading fraud investigations, including case management, evidence coordination, and investigation oversight. Acts as the primary investigator for fraud incidents.

raw_entities.name: Technology Team
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for providing system analysis and log review during fraud investigations to identify technical evidence, attack vectors, and system vulnerabilities.

raw_entities.name: Legal
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for legal oversight and coordination when law enforcement is involved in fraud investigations, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and evidence handling.

raw_entities.name: External Forensics
raw_entities.description: External specialist role engaged to conduct forensic analysis when data breach is suspected as part of fraud investigation, providing technical expertise in breach investigation.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Obligation
raw_entities.description: Formal fraud investigation process triggered by confirmed unauthorized fraud, multiple incidents, systemic patterns, or law enforcement referral. Encompasses investigation team assembly, evidence collection, analysis, and prevention recommendations.

raw_entities.name: System Logs Audit Trail
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring retention and analysis of system logs to preserve technical evidence during fraud investigations and maintain audit trail of system activities.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Records Evidence Control
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring protection and preservation of transaction records as evidence during fraud investigations to maintain chain of custody and data integrity.

raw_entities.name: Customer Communications Archive
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring archival of customer communications as evidence during fraud investigations to preserve contemporaneous records and customer interactions.

properties.core_policy_statement: The bank shall conduct formal fraud investigations when triggered by confirmed unauthorized fraud exceeding £1,000, multiple incidents, systemic patterns, or law enforcement referrals, with documented timelines, perpetrator identification, attack method analysis, loss quantification, and prevention recommendations.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to all fraud incidents meeting investigation triggers; covers investigation process, team composition, required investigation elements, and evidence preservation obligations.

properties.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Confirmed Unauthorized Fraud Threshold

properties.consequence_of_breach: Failure to investigate confirmed unauthorized fraud above threshold may result in regulatory non-compliance and customer harm
Failure to investigate multiple fraud incidents may allow systemic fraud to continue undetected
Failure to investigate identified fraud patterns may result in continued losses and regulatory breach

properties.name: Fraud Investigation Trigger - Law Enforcement Referral

properties.consequence_of_breach: Failure to investigate law enforcement referrals may obstruct justice and breach regulatory obligations

properties.name: Fraud Investigation Elements - Attack Method Analysis

properties.consequence_of_breach: Loss of audit trail may compromise investigation integrity and regulatory compliance
Loss of transaction records may prevent fraud investigation and customer reimbursement
Loss of customer communications may compromise investigation and dispute resolution
Failure to cooperate with law enforcement may result in regulatory sanctions and obstruction charges

properties.risk_definition: Fraudulent transactions conducted without customer authorization
properties.required_response: Formal investigation if confirmed and exceeds £1,000 threshold

properties.risk_definition: Multiple fraud incidents indicating a systemic vulnerability or organized fraud scheme
properties.reporting_obligation: Investigation team, management, and potentially law enforcement

properties.risk_definition: Unauthorized access to customer or transaction data that may have enabled fraud
properties.reporting_obligation: Investigation team, Legal, and law enforcement

specific_obligations: provide legal guidance when law enforcement involved
authority: advise on legal implications of investigation findings

specific_obligations: conduct forensic analysis when data breach suspected

generation_trigger: multiple fraud incidents same customer or merchant
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Financial Crime staff leads investigation with Technology team, Legal (if law enforcement involved), and External forensics (if data breach suspected)
properties.evidence_preservation_requirement: System logs, transaction records, customer communications must be retained and protected

properties.escalation_path: Logs provided to investigation team lead
Records provided to investigation team for analysis
Communications provided to investigation team for review
